goal: Measure Qwen2.5-Omni-7B GPTQ-Int4 audio->audio on L4 before any Twilio refactor

vram.audio_only_note: Official numbers are video. Audio-only turns must stay short. Keep thinker.visual on CPU. Do not keep 60s of audio context.
vram.cpu_offload_note: Official INT4 demo offloads visual and audio_tower to CPU. That saves VRAM and adds latency. Phone S2S should keep audio_tower on CUDA.

streaming.transformers_generate: Returns the full 24 kHz waveform when generate() finishes. Not a Twilio 20 ms frame iterator.
streaming.official_int4_token2wav: Internal streaming exists to avoid pre-allocating VRAM. The Python API still waits for the complete audio.
streaming.vllm_openai_current_stack: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.10.2 serves thinker text only. No talker, no S2S.
streaming.vllm_omni: Separate project. Text can stream. Audio is returned at the end of the stage.
streaming.dashscope_cloud: True audio streaming exists in the cloud API. That is not the L4 target.

function_calling.local_generate: No first-class tools argument on official generate().
function_calling.thinker_path: Thinker is Qwen2.5. A prompt-level tool loop with return_audio=False is the only local path that can call Fastify.
function_calling.s2s_risk: If tools stay on the speech path, Talker may read tool JSON aloud.
function_calling.cloud_dashscope: Function calling is documented on the hosted Omni API only.

french.system_prompt_constraint: Audio output requires the official Qwen system prompt. Restaurant style must be primed as a user/assistant turn.

cannot_cohabit_with: Smart Turn as a second orchestrator

run.reason: dry-run on a host without loading weights

notes: Twilio stays disconnected until a measured L4 run exists.
